results.title: Gateway version observation (spec OBS-RLSD-01)
results.desc: Gateway /health must report the observed gateway_version used for release distribution
results.detail: Health RPC (openshell.v1.OpenShell/Health, gRPC-web) returns status=1 + version 0.1.6-rhaiv.2 — identical to GetGatewayInfo gateway_version; no REST /health endpoint exists on the gateway route (404 on /health, /healthz, /ready, /metrics...; the spec's '/health' is the gRPC Health RPC)
results.prose: Random spec draw: gateway-release-distribution.spec.md, requirement OBS-RLSD-01 — fleet gateways counted by the version they report on health. First probe taught me the spec's '/health endpoint' is not REST: every plain path 404s on the gateway route. The actual source is the gRPC Health RPC, which returns status=1 and version 0.1.6-rhaiv.2 — byte-identical to GetGatewayInfo's gateway_version. The release-distribution aggregation input is consistent across both surfaces, so the dashboard's per-version counts would be built on coherent data. Fleet-wide counting still needs the owner token (dead).
results.steps: Random spec selection: find specs -name '*.spec.md' | shuf -n1 → gateway-release-distribution.spec.md; read OBS-RLSD-01; GetGatewayInfo for gRPC-reported version; GET /health on the gateway route; compare.
